IT Support Guide

Employees can contact the IT Help Desk for laptop, software, network, VPN, and access-related issues.

For critical production issues, employees should contact the IT Help Desk immediately and mark the ticket as high priority.

For password reset requests, employees should use the company's self-service password reset portal.

VPN problems should first be checked by restarting the VPN client and verifying the internet connection.
If the problem continues, employees should create an IT support ticket with a description of the issue and relevant screenshots.

Company Leave Policy

Employees are entitled to 24 paid leaves per calendar year.

Employees can carry forward a maximum of 10 unused paid leaves to the next calendar year.

Employees must apply for planned leave at least 3 working days in advance.

For emergency leave, employees should inform their manager as soon as possible.

Employees who join the company during the year receive leave on a prorated basis.
Unused leaves above the maximum carry-forward limit will expire at the end of the calendar year.

Work From Home Policy

Employees can work from home up to 2 days per week.

Work from home requests must be submitted through the company's employee portal.

Employees should obtain manager approval before taking work-from-home days.

Employees must remain available during their normal working hours while working from home.

Some projects may have different work-from-home rules depending on client requirements.
